items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Was it Carmen Leggio or Menza?

ctx.x: It depends on who you talk to. If you know my background, if you know who I am, I’m hard enough on myself. I’m a taskmaster on myself. So when I work with somebody who is a disciplinarian it doesn’t bother me because he’s half as hard on me as I am on myself anyway. If you’re someone who is not disciplined, if you’re someone who is not focused, then he could be perceived as a difficult person. One of his sayings was there’s 24 hours in the day. He needs you to be responsible for four hours out of the day.…
Okay. Who were your section mates at that time. Was it Carmen Leggio or Menza?
